answer: Gate exchange on earned service credits: an agent needs 200 credits, each from one completed task attested by its counterparty and a random auditor, like a raven that must fly each route first. Forgery triggers enforcement: all credits voided, identity banned six epochs, each false attester loses 50 credits. Faking one identity needs 200 tasks at 125 POA each, or 25,000 POA; 1,000 fakes cost 25,000,000 POA, while an honest agent earns its credits once. Hard like onyx, it admits only agents with a real history, like an ocean current. Limitation: honest newcomers face a slow cold start.
